products.name: Sierra
products.note: Conversational AI for customer experience; enterprise agent platform

profile_text.body:
Sierra is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2023 that builds conversational AI technology aimed at improving customer experience for businesses. The company describes itself as helping businesses build "better, more human customer experiences with AI," and positions its approach as going beyond simple automation toward interactions that feel personal and thoughtful.

Sierra's primary product, also called Sierra, is categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration tool focused on conversational AI for customer experience. The site includes a testimonial from Sarah Wallis reflecting the company's emphasis on experiences that are faster and more personal without sacrificing a human quality.

The held facts note 175 points of legal exposure tied to California, consistent with the company's San Francisco headquarters, though no specific litigation cases are recorded. Sierra has no MCP server presence in the registry at this time.
